//go:build ignore

package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"crypto/x509"
	"io"
	"net"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"time"

	kube "asservat.local/asservat/internal/adapters/kubernetes"
	"asservat.local/asservat/internal/adapters/mtls"
	"asservat.local/asservat/internal/adapters/postgres"
	"asservat.local/asservat/internal/bootstrap"
	wire "asservat.local/asservat/internal/transport/clusterobservation"
	"asservat.local/asservat/internal/transport/native"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"k8s.io/client-go/rest"
)

// One instance lives for the complete fixture process. In particular neither
// SQL nor API clients/rate limiters are recreated for successive requests.
type fixtureRuntime struct {
	input                   fixtureInput
	root                    context.Context
	cancel                  context.CancelFunc
	metrics                 metrics
	pools                   map[string]*pgxpool.Pool
	observer, probe         *kube.PermissionClient
	guard                   *kube.OwnerWorkloadProtection
	owners                  *postgres.OwnerEnrollments
	hwork                   *bootstrap.DirectHolderObservationClient
	holder                  *wire.HubObservationOperationHolder
	regional                *mtls.ConnectorObservationOperationClient
	mu                      sync.Mutex
	stream                  *mtls.ConnectorObservationOperationConnection
	streamCancel            context.CancelFunc
	streamDone              chan error
	streamResult            error
	streamJoined            bool
	cleanups                []func()
	closeOnce               sync.Once
	shutdownRequested       atomic.Bool
	diagnosticMu            sync.Mutex
	lastPhase, lastCategory string
	lastElapsed             int64
	regionalFinished        bool
	regionalCategory        string
}

func newRuntime(ctx context.Context, in fixtureInput) (r *fixtureRuntime, err error) {
	root, cancel := context.WithDeadline(ctx, in.Until)
	r = &fixtureRuntime{input: in, root: root, cancel: cancel, pools: map[string]*pgxpool.Pool{}}
	defer func() {
		if err != nil {
			// Report the actual setup failure before waiting for cleanup. A
			// cleanup wait must not conceal the earlier failed boundary.
			emitFailure("composition", err)
			joined := beginPhase("failed-composition-join")
			r.Close()
			joined(nil)
		}
	}()
	allowed := map[string][]string{
		"hwork":    {"owner-read"},
		"owner":    {"owner-read", "owner-write", "owner-ack", "owner-activate", "connector-read"},
		"regional": {"owner-read", "connector-journal", "connector-ack", "connector-read", "recovery-read"},
	}[in.Mode]
	if len(allowed) == 0 || len(in.SQL) != len(allowed) {
		return r, errFixture
	}
	for purpose, configuration := range in.SQL {
		if !slices.Contains(allowed, purpose) {
			return r, errFixture
		}
		phase := beginPhase("sql-" + purpose)
		pool, e := newPool(root, configuration)
		phase(e)
		if e != nil {
			return r, e
		}
		r.pools[purpose] = pool
		r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, pool.Close)
	}
	makeAPI := func(path string, probe bool) (*kube.PermissionClient, error) {
		if path != "/fixture/observer.token" && path != "/fixture/probe.token" {
			return nil, errFixture
		}
		config := &rest.Config{Host: in.API.Host, BearerTokenFile: path, TLSClientConfig: rest.TLSClientConfig{CAData: in.API.CA}, WrapTransport: r.metrics.wrap(probe)}
		return kube.NewPermissionClient(config, in.API.ClusterID, in.API.Control, time.Now)
	}
	apiPhase := beginPhase("native-clients")
	r.observer, err = makeAPI(in.API.ObserverTokenFile, false)
	if err != nil {
		apiPhase(err)
		return r, err
	}
	r.probe, err = makeAPI(in.API.ProbeTokenFile, true)
	if err != nil {
		apiPhase(err)
		return r, err
	}
	r.guard, err = kube.NewOwnerWorkloadProtection(r.observer, r.probe, in.API.Workload, in.API.WorkloadPin)
	apiPhase(err)
	if err != nil {
		return r, err
	}
	p := in.Owner.Pool
	ownerRead := beginPhase("owner-read-constructor")
	r.owners, err = postgres.NewOwnerEnrollments(root, r.pools["owner-read"], p.InstallationID, p.ClusterID, p.NamespaceUID, in.Owner.SourceUID, uuid.NewString)
	ownerRead(err)
	if err != nil {
		return r, err
	}
	ownerRoots, err := rootsFromDER([][]byte{in.OwnerCA.DER})
	if err != nil {
		return r, err
	}
	switch in.Mode {
	case "hwork":
		if in.CallerTokenFile != "/fixture/caller.token" {
			return r, errFixture
		}
		endpoints, e := kube.NewOwnerEndpoints(r.observer, p)
		if e != nil {
			return r, e
		}
		proof, e := kube.NewOwnerObservationOperationReader(r.observer, r.guard, in.Owner)
		if e != nil {
			return r, e
		}
		r.hwork, err = bootstrap.NewDirectHolderObservationClient(root, in.Owner, in.PodUID, ownerRoots, r.owners, endpoints, proof, fileToken(in.CallerTokenFile), 2, time.Now)
		if err != nil {
			return r, err
		}
		r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, r.hwork.Close)
	case "owner":
		if err = r.startOwner(ownerRoots); err != nil {
			return r, phaseError{"owner-composition", err}
		}
	case "regional":
		if err = r.startRegional(ownerRoots); err != nil {
			return r, phaseError{"regional-composition", err}
		}
	default:
		return r, errFixture
	}
	if root.Err() != nil {
		return r, root.Err()
	}
	return r, nil
}

func newPool(ctx context.Context, in fixtureSQL) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
	if in.DSN == "" || len(in.DSN) > 16384 || in.ServerName == "" {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	roots := x509.NewCertPool()
	if !roots.AppendCertsFromPEM(in.Roots) {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	config, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(in.DSN)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	if config.ConnConfig.User == "" || config.ConnConfig.User == "postgres" || config.ConnConfig.Tracer != nil {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	config.MaxConns = 1
	config.MinConns = 0
	config.ConnConfig.TLSConfig = &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13, RootCAs: roots, ServerName: in.ServerName}
	config.ConnConfig.Fallbacks = nil
	pool, err := pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, config)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	if err = pool.Ping(ctx); err != nil {
		pool.Close()
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	return pool, nil
}
func rootsFromDER(ders [][]byte) (*x509.CertPool, error) {
	if len(ders) < 1 || len(ders) > 8 {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	roots := x509.NewCertPool()
	for _, der := range ders {
		c, e := x509.ParseCertificate(der)
		if e != nil || !c.IsCA {
			return nil, errFixture
		}
		roots.AddCert(c)
	}
	return roots, nil
}

type fileToken string

func (f fileToken) read(ctx context.Context) ([]byte, error) {
	if ctx == nil || ctx.Err() != nil {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	file, e := os.Open(string(f))
	if e != nil {
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	defer file.Close()
	b, e := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 16385))
	if e != nil || len(b) == 0 || len(b) > 16384 || ctx.Err() != nil {
		clear(b)
		return nil, errFixture
	}
	return b, nil
}
func (f fileToken) ReadOwnerPodToken(c context.Context) ([]byte, error)           { return f.read(c) }
func (f fileToken) ReadConnectorPodToken(c context.Context) ([]byte, error)       { return f.read(c) }
func (f fileToken) ReadClusterObservationToken(c context.Context) ([]byte, error) { return f.read(c) }

func (r *fixtureRuntime) startOwner(roots *x509.CertPool) (err error) {
	phase := beginPhase("owner-enrollment")
	server, err := r.enrollOwner(roots)
	phase(err)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, server.Close)
	backend := beginPhase("owner-backend")
	defer func() { backend(err) }()
	r.holder, err = wire.NewHubObservationOperationHolder(r.root, 2, time.Now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, r.holder.Close)
	proof, err := kube.NewOwnerLocalObservationOperationReader(r.observer, r.guard, r.input.Owner, r.input.Caller)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	receiver, err := bootstrap.NewOwnerLocalObservationReceiver(r.root, r.input.Owner, server, r.owners, proof, r.holder, 2, time.Now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, receiver.Close)
	peers := []mtls.OwnerObservationPeer{{Binding: r.input.Regional.Profile.Binding, Roots: r.input.Regional.Profile.ClientIssuerRoots}}
	ingress, err := mtls.NewOwnerObservationOperationIngress(r.input.Owner, server, peers, time.Now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	registry, err := postgres.NewConnectorObservationOperationRegistry(r.root, r.pools["connector-read"], r.input.Regional)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	handler, err := bootstrap.NewRegionalObservationOperationHandler(receiver.CommonAuthority(), r.holder, r.input.Regional, ingress, registry, time.Now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	serving, err := mtls.NewOwnerBootstrapServing(server, r.input.Owner.Pool)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	peerRoots, err := rootsFromDER(r.input.Regional.Profile.ClientIssuerRoots)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", ":9444")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	done := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		err := native.ServeOwnerObservationOperation(r.root, listener, peerRoots, serving, receiver, handler, 2, 2)
		if err != nil && r.root.Err() == nil {
			emitFailure("native-listener", err)
			r.cancel()
		}
		done <- err
	}()
	r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, func() { _ = listener.Close(); <-done })
	return nil
}

func (r *fixtureRuntime) startRegional(ownerRoots *x509.CertPool) (err error) {
	if r.input.ConnectorTokenFile != "/fixture/connector.token" {
		return errFixture
	}
	sourcePhase := beginPhase("regional-source")
	protection, err := kube.NewConnectorIdentityProtection(r.observer, r.probe, r.input.ConnectorSourcePlan, r.input.ConnectorSourcePin)
	if err != nil {
		sourcePhase(err)
		return err
	}
	source, err := kube.NewConnectorIdentitySource(r.observer, protection, r.input.ConnectorSourceName, r.input.ConnectorSourceUID, r.input.Regional.Profile.RootID, r.input.Regional.Profile.Binding)
	sourcePhase(err)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	enrollment := beginPhase("regional-enrollment")
	credentials, err := r.enrollConnector(source)
	enrollment(err)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, credentials.Close)
	backend := beginPhase("regional-backend")
	defer func() { backend(err) }()
	nativeReader, err := kube.NewConnectorObservationOperationReader(r.observer, source, r.guard, fileToken(r.input.ConnectorTokenFile), r.input.Regional)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	producer, err := mtls.NewConnectorObservationOperationProducer(r.input.Regional, credentials, nativeReader, time.Now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	guard, err := kube.NewCapacityNamespaceGuard(r.observer, r.probe, r.input.CapacityPlan, r.input.CapacityPin)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	metadata, err := kube.NewClusterObservationMetadata(r.observer, guard, r.input.Owner.RootID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.regional, err = mtls.NewConnectorObservationOperationClient(r.root, r.input.Owner, r.input.RegionalDial, ownerRoots, producer, r.owners, r.owners, metadata, 1, time.Now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.cleanups = append(r.cleanups, r.regional.Close)
	return nil
}

func (r *fixtureRuntime) Close() {
	if r == nil {
		return
	}
	r.closeOnce.Do(func() {
		joined := beginPhase("shutdown")
		r.cancel()
		r.closeStream()
		for i := len(r.cleanups) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			r.cleanups[i]()
		}
		joined(nil)
	})
}

// No result or error contains an authority value reconstructed from an ID.
// Explicit status only reads holder/socket routing availability.
func (r *fixtureRuntime) command(ctx context.Context, q controlRequest) controlResult {
	start := time.Now()
	out := controlResult{Phase: q.Command}
	var err error
	switch q.Command {
	case "status":
		r.diagnosticMu.Lock()
		out.LastPhase, out.LastCategory, out.LastElapsedNanos = r.lastPhase, r.lastCategory, r.lastElapsed
		out.RegionalFinished, out.RegionalCategory = r.regionalFinished, r.regionalCategory
		r.diagnosticMu.Unlock()
		if r.holder != nil {
			_, out.Available, err = r.holder.LookupAvailable(ctx, r.input.Owner.RootID, r.input.Regional.Profile.Binding.ClusterID)
		} else {
			out.Available = r.root.Err() == nil
		}
	case "observe":
		if r.hwork == nil || !q.Request.Valid(time.Now()) {
			err = errFixture
			break
		}
		call, cancel := context.WithDeadline(ctx, q.Request.NotAfter)
		result, e := r.hwork.ObserveCluster(call, q.Request)
		cancel()
		err = e
		if e == nil {
			out.Result = &result
		}
		out.RemainingNanos = time.Until(q.Request.NotAfter).Nanoseconds()
	case "open":
		err = r.openStream(ctx, q.ExchangeID)
		out.ExchangeID = q.ExchangeID
	case "join":
		err = r.joinStream(ctx)
	case "close":
		r.closeStream()
	case "shutdown":
		r.shutdownRequested.Store(true)
		r.Close()
	default:
		err = errFixture
	}
	out.OK = err == nil
	out.Category = errorCategory(err)
	out.ElapsedNanos = time.Since(start).Nanoseconds()
	out.CompletedAt = time.Now().UTC()
	if q.Command != "status" {
		r.diagnosticMu.Lock()
		r.lastPhase, r.lastCategory, r.lastElapsed = q.Command, out.Category, out.ElapsedNanos
		r.diagnosticMu.Unlock()
	}
	out.Metrics = r.metrics.snapshot(r.pools)
	return out
}

func (r *fixtureRuntime) openStream(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	if r.regional == nil || r.stream != nil || ctx.Err() != nil {
		return errFixture
	}
	// The control request only initiates setup. The original finite process
	// root retains the admitted socket after the command reply, with its own
	// original thirty-second maximum; closing a CLI does not relabel it.
	root, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.root, 30*time.Second)
	done := make(chan struct{})
	stop := context.AfterFunc(ctx, func() { cancel(); close(done) })
	stream, err := r.regional.Open(root, id)
	if !stop() {
		<-done
	}
	if err != nil || ctx.Err() != nil {
		cancel()
		if stream != nil {
			_ = stream.Close()
		}
		return errFixture
	}
	r.stream = stream
	r.streamCancel = cancel
	r.streamDone = make(chan error, 1)
	r.streamJoined = false
	r.streamResult = nil
	joined := r.streamDone
	r.diagnosticMu.Lock()
	r.regionalFinished, r.regionalCategory = false, ""
	r.diagnosticMu.Unlock()
	go func() {
		err := wire.ServeRegionalObservationOperation(stream.Context(), stream, time.Now)
		r.diagnosticMu.Lock()
		r.regionalFinished, r.regionalCategory = true, errorCategory(err)
		r.diagnosticMu.Unlock()
		joined <- err
	}()
	return nil
}
func (r *fixtureRuntime) joinStream(ctx context.Context) error {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	if r.stream == nil {
		return errFixture
	}
	if !r.streamJoined {
		select {
		case r.streamResult = <-r.streamDone:
			r.streamJoined = true
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	return r.streamResult
}
func (r *fixtureRuntime) closeStream() {
	r.mu.Lock()
	defer r.mu.Unlock()
	if r.stream == nil {
		return
	}
	r.streamCancel()
	_ = r.stream.Close()
	if !r.streamJoined {
		r.streamResult = <-r.streamDone
		r.streamJoined = true
	}
	r.stream = nil
	r.streamCancel = nil
}
